say:1:1033459001:1.text: All those grand words of his were lies!
say:1:1033459001:1.source_cn: 难道不是吗？他在大家面前所说的那些豪言壮语，全部都是谎言！
say:1:1033459001:1.male: All those grand words of his were lies!
say:1:1033459001:1.female: All those grand words of his were lies!

say:2:1033459002:1.text: He tricked the Thorned Guards into working for his goals.
say:2:1033459002:1.source_cn: 他凭借着那些谎言，让荆棘卫队为他自己的目的而奔走。
say:2:1033459002:1.male: He tricked the Thorned Guards into working for his goals.
say:2:1033459002:1.female: He tricked the Thorned Guards into working for his goals.

say:3:1033459003:1.text: We are ashamed! We were just his tools!
say:3:1033459003:1.source_cn: 没有什么荣光！我们只是被利用的工具！
say:3:1033459003:1.male: We are ashamed! We were just his tools!
say:3:1033459003:1.female: We are ashamed! We were just his tools!
